pack.title: Glasswind Lenses
pack.description: Original categorical displays and fictional role prompts for the deterministic Character projection workflow.
pack.methodology: Each candidate declares signed weights over canonical HEXACO factors or facets. Available values are converted to millionths, centered around 0.5, multiplied by signed integer weights, summed, and divided by covered absolute weight. Missing values reduce coverage and contribute no value. Eligible candidates are ranked by score, then a pinned SHA-256 seed trace, then stable identifiers.
pack.limitations: These labels are optional fictional writing prompts. They do not measure aptitude, diagnose a person, recommend employment, predict conduct, establish a normative distribution, or replace authored character canon. Capacity values demonstrate project allocation policy only.
